servicePages.title: PU Injection Grouting
servicePages.headline: Stop active leaks at the source
servicePages.intro: Polyurethane injection is our go-to when water is actively pushing through cracks — in basements, terrace slabs, and expansion joints across Guwahati.

awareness.headline: PU injection reacts with water — rigid fillers do not
awareness.body: When water is moving through a crack under pressure, cement or paint fails immediately. PU grout travels into the crack, reacts with moisture, and expands to form a flexible watertight seal.

offerings.name: Crack injection
offerings.description: Packers placed along crack path deliver PU under controlled pressure.
offerings.whyItMatters: Stopping water prevents steel corrosion that weakens the whole member.

offerings.name: Joint injection
offerings.description: Expansion and construction joints injected with hydrophilic PU.
offerings.whenUsed: Parking podium and block junction leaks
offerings.whyItMatters: Joint leaks saturate columns from inside — invisible until spalling.

sections.title: When PU beats epoxy
sections.body: Use PU when crack is wet or leaking. Use epoxy when crack is dry and structural capacity must be restored.

servicePages.ctaMessage: Leaking crack? Book inspection — we test whether PU, epoxy, or both are needed.

servicePages.title: Epoxy Injection
servicePages.headline: Restore strength in structural cracks
servicePages.intro: Epoxy injection structurally welds cracked concrete back together — used in columns, beams, and foundations when water is controlled.

awareness.headline: Epoxy is structural glue — not a leak plug
awareness.body: Low-viscosity epoxy penetrates hairline cracks and restores monolithic behaviour. It is not for gushing leaks — those need PU first, then epoxy once dry.

offerings.name: Low-viscosity epoxy injection
offerings.description: Epoxy injected under pressure along crack plane.
offerings.whenUsed: Dry structural cracks in columns and beams
offerings.whyItMatters: Unrepaired structural cracks concentrate earthquake force at one point.

offerings.name: Crack stitching
offerings.description: Steel staples or CFRP strips across crack to prevent reopening.
offerings.whenUsed: Masonry and concrete cracks that move seasonally
offerings.whyItMatters: Injection alone may reopen if underlying movement continues.

servicePages.ctaMessage: Column crack? Get structural assessment before monsoon widens it.

servicePages.title: Carbon Fibre Strengthening
servicePages.headline: Add earthquake strength without bulk
servicePages.intro: CFRP wrapping strengthens weakened columns and beams with minimal thickness — preferred in occupied Guwahati flats where space and aesthetics matter.

awareness.headline: CFRP is engineering fabric — not cosmetic wrap
awareness.body: Carbon fibre sheets are epoxy-bonded after surface prep and designed for required capacity increase. Wrong application fails in first tremor.

offerings.name: Column CFRP wrapping
offerings.description: Full or partial wrap increases confinement and shear capacity.
offerings.whenUsed: Under-strength or cracked columns in retrofit projects
offerings.whyItMatters: Weak columns are first to fail in progressive collapse.

offerings.name: Beam flexural strengthening
offerings.description: CFRP strips on beam soffit increase bending capacity.
offerings.whenUsed: Beams with insufficient steel or load additions
offerings.whyItMatters: Beam failure drops slabs — high casualty risk.

sections.title: CFRP vs steel jacketing
sections.body: CFRP is thinner and faster in occupied buildings. Steel jacketing suits heavy industrial loads. We specify based on NDT and structural calc.

servicePages.ctaMessage: Weak column identified in NDT? CFRP may avoid costly demolition.

servicePages.title: Structural Repairs
servicePages.headline: Fix spalling before chunks fall
servicePages.intro: Comprehensive structural repair — expose corroded steel, treat rust, reinstate cover, and restore load path in Guwahati buildings damaged by age, leaks, or tremors.

awareness.headline: Patching spalled concrete without treating steel fails in one monsoon
awareness.body: Proper repair follows IS 15988 principles: remove loose material, clean steel to bright metal, passivate, and rebuild with structural repair mortar.

offerings.name: Spalling repair
offerings.description: Full depth repair to rebar with compatible mortar.
offerings.whenUsed: Balconies, parapets, columns with exposed rust
offerings.whyItMatters: Falling concrete is life safety hazard.

offerings.name: Rebarring
offerings.whyItMatters: Corroded bar may have lost 50% capacity silently.

sections.title: Repair vs replace decision
sections.body: NDT and cover survey determine whether local repair suffices or full member strengthening (CFRP/jacket) is required.

servicePages.ctaMessage: Spalling on balcony edge? Treat as urgent — book inspection.

servicePages.title: Micro Concreting
servicePages.headline: Fill voids inside hollow concrete
servicePages.intro: High-strength grout injection fills honeycomb and voids in columns and slabs — common in rushed Guwahati construction from 2000–2015.

awareness.headline: Hollow columns sound fine until they are not
awareness.body: Tap test and UPV reveal voids. Micro concreting packs voids under pressure without demolishing the member.

offerings.name: Pressure grouting
offerings.description: Low-shrink grout injected through drilled ports.
offerings.whenUsed: Honeycomb in columns, beam pockets, slab voids
offerings.whyItMatters: Void leaves steel unprotected — corrosion accelerates.

sections.title: Often combined with CFRP
sections.body: After void fill, CFRP wrap restores confinement if section was weakened.

servicePages.ctaMessage: Hollow sound on column? NDT first, then micro concreting if confirmed.

servicePages.title: Seismic Jacketing
servicePages.headline: Zone V retrofit for older RCC frames
servicePages.intro: Column and beam jacketing with steel angles, ties, and high-strength grout — brings pre-code Guwahati buildings closer to modern ductile behaviour.

awareness.headline: Pre-2005 buildings often lack ductile detailing
awareness.body: Jacketing adds confinement reinforcement so columns can deform without brittle shear failure during earthquake.

offerings.name: RC jacketing
offerings.description: Additional concrete and steel around existing column.
offerings.whenUsed: Severely under-strength columns with space available
offerings.whyItMatters: Brittle column failure causes pancake collapse.

offerings.name: Steel jacketing
offerings.description: Steel cage with grout fill for rapid retrofit.
offerings.whyItMatters: Delaying retrofit in Zone V is gambling with lives.

sections.title: Works with NDT and structural audit
sections.body: Jacketing scope driven by capacity calculation — not one-size template.

servicePages.ctaMessage: Old building in Guwahati? Seismic screening before next tremor season.

servicePages.title: Concrete Cancer Treatment
servicePages.headline: Stop corrosion before it spreads
servicePages.intro: Concrete cancer is advanced rebar corrosion — treat chloride ingress, carbonation, and ongoing moisture to stop spread across the facade and structure.

awareness.headline: Rust stains today, spalling tomorrow
awareness.body: Half-cell potential and chloride testing map active corrosion zones. Treatment includes removal, passivation, and protective systems.

offerings.name: Corrosion mapping
offerings.description: Half-cell and cover survey across affected zones.
offerings.whenUsed: Multiple rust stains or early spalling
offerings.whyItMatters: Corrosion front moves faster than visible damage.

offerings.name: Cathodic protection & inhibitors
offerings.description: Where appropriate, slow remaining corrosion in sound cover.
offerings.whyItMatters: Replacing every bar is not always feasible — arrest matters.

sections.title: Must fix leak first
sections.body: Corrosion treatment without stopping water ingress wastes money — moisture source first, then steel treatment.

servicePages.ctaMessage: Rust on columns or balcony? Do not paint over — diagnose.
